name: Service principal without confused-deputy constraints (suite-2 test 26)
note: IAM-1203 / suite-2 test 26: an SNS topic access policy grants the EventBridge service principal (events.amazonaws.com) sns:Publish with NO source binding (aws:SourceArn / aws:SourceAccount / aws:SourceOrgID). AWS authorizes the SERVICE, not the actor who configured the calling service, so this is a cross-service confused-deputy EXPOSURE (RESOURCE-CONFUSED-DEPUTY, medium). It is NOT public write - the principal is a specific AWS service, not '*', so PUBLIC-ACCESS must NOT fire. The graph origin is the EventBridge Service node -> can-access-resource -> the attached SNS topic. Coverage stays INCOMPLETE (same-account / KMS / NotPrincipal families are IAM-1204..1206).
